Join the {creature:Efreet|Efreets}, the green djinns of {wiki:Mal'ouquah|Mal'ouquah}, in the war against the {creature:Marid|Marids}. In three missions you find the supply thief, steal the {item:Tear of Daraman} from the blue djinns and swap King Gabel's lamp for Fa'hradin's lamp. At the end you can trade with {npc:Yaman} and {npc:Alesar}, who buy and sell strong equipment.
Ally with the mighty Efreets, a race almost forgotten by the sands of time, to win the djinns' eternal war against their rivals, the fearsome Marids.
Not having chosen the Marids' side: you can only ally with **one** of the djinn factions.
against the drunkenness of the djinns in the blue fortress
optional, to protect yourself when you talk to the Orc King
A strong team for mission 3 (climbing to the top of the Marids' fortress)
Ability to hunt {creature:Marid|Marids} and {creature:Blue Djinn|Blue Djinns} in Ankrahmun and Yalahar
Access to the Blue Djinn hunting task ({wiki:Killing in the Name of... Quest|Killing in the Name of...}) with {npc:Malor}
Mission 3 (*Orc Fortress*): when you report to {npc:Malor}, you can trade with {npc:Yaman} and {npc:Alesar}.
You can only ally with **one** faction: after this one you can no longer do {wiki:The Djinn War - Marid Faction}.
Hunting Marids and Blue Djinns in Ankrahmun and Yalahar
Mission 3 (*Orc Fortress*): after reporting, ask {npc:Malor} for a {key:task}.

If you have not yet done the {wiki:To Appease the Mighty Quest|To Appease the Mighty Quest} (20 {item:Platinum Coin|Platinum Coins}), do it **before** starting the Djinn War: afterwards it is no longer possible.
The choice is final: once you ally with the Efreets you cannot work for the Marids. The Efreets and the Marids buy and sell different items.
Greet the djinns with {key:DJANNI'HAH} (instead of {key:hi}) until you join the Efreets. After that, {key:hi} works too.
Bring {item:Dwarven Ring|Dwarven Rings} and companions (good shooters and blockers) for the visits to the Marids' fortress.

Travel to {wiki:Ankrahmun|Ankrahmun} by boat (for example, from Venore with {npc:Captain Fearless} or from Edron with {npc:Captain Seahorse}: {key:hi}, {key:ankrahmun}, {key:yes}); you disembark next to {npc:Captain Sinbeard}. In Ankrahmun, look for the blind beggar {npc:Melchior}, who walks the streets. Say {key:hi} and {key:word of greeting}. He teaches you the djinn word: **DJANNI'HAH**. From here you can enter either of the fortresses.
2. Entering Mal'ouquah and joining the Efreets

Go up the ramp **west** of the oasis and follow the path **west** until you see the level 30 {item:Door of Expertise|doors of expertise}. Behind them is {wiki:Mal'ouquah|Mal'ouquah}, the fortress of the green djinns. To leave, go back the same way to the ramp and go down to Ankrahmun.

At the entrance, talk to {npc:Ubaid} saying {key:DJANNI'HAH} (do not say "hi"). Ask for {key:passage}. When he tells you to go away, answer {key:no}. When he asks whether you want to fight the Marids, say {key:yes} and swear loyalty to King Malor with {key:yes}. He tells you to talk to General {npc:Baa'Leal}.
This choice is final: from here on you are on the Efreets' side.
Talk to {npc:Baa'Leal} using {key:DJANNI'HAH}, then {key:mission} and {key:yes}. He sends you to Thais to find the supply thief.

If you do not use {key:DJANNI'HAH}, Baa'leal casts *soulfire* on you: 150 ticks of fire damage, 1500 damage in total, over 12.5 minutes. To get rid of it, go to a temple to be healed, jump in the water or wait for it to pass.
Finding Partos in the Thais prison

Travel to **Thais** (from Ankrahmun, {npc:Captain Sinbeard} takes you to Venore, {key:venore}, and there {npc:Captain Fearless} takes you to Thais, {key:thais}) and go down to the prison at the marked spot. Find the prisoner {npc:Partos} in an underground cell. Say {key:hi}, {key:ankrahmun} and {key:supplies}. He refuses to talk, but you already know the thief's name: **Partos** (it is also in your Quest Log). Leave the prison by the same stairs.
Way down to the Thais prison

Go back to Mal'ouquah (in Thais, {npc:Captain Bluebear} takes you to Venore or Edron, {key:venore}/{key:edron}, and from there you take the boat to Ankrahmun, {key:ankrahmun}) and tell {npc:Baa'Leal}: {key:DJANNI'HAH}, {key:mission}, {key:yes} and the thief's name, {key:partos}. You receive 600 gp and he tells you to talk to {npc:Alesar}.
Talk to {npc:Alesar}: {key:DJANNI'HAH}, {key:mission} and {key:yes}. He wants you to steal a {item:Tear of Daraman} from the Marids' fortress, {wiki:Ashta'daramai|Ashta'daramai}.
Go to the ramp between Ankrahmun and Darashia. Instead of heading north towards Darashia, follow the passage **west** and go down the hidden ramp to the **south**.
Path to the hidden ramp to the Marids' secret entrance
After going down the ramp you will meet one or more {creature:Stone Golem|Stone Golems}. Keep going **south** to the secret entrance of the blue djinns' fortress.

Go up the stairs to the **4th floor** (one floor above the {creature:Fire Elemental|Fire Elementals}). Look for two fountains on the **east** side of the room. The higher you go, the more {creature:Blue Djinn|Blue Djinns}, {creature:Marid|Marids}, {creature:Fire Elemental|Fire Elementals} and {creature:Scarab|Scarabs} you meet.
As soon as you go up to the 3rd floor you may have up to 5 Blue Djinns, 1 Marid, 4 Fire Elementals and 2 Scarabs waiting for you!
Bring {item:Dwarven Ring|Dwarven Rings} and, if possible, good shooters and blockers.
Of the two fountains, **use the northern one**. The water ripples and a {item:Tear of Daraman} appears on the floor, under you. Pick it up.
Go down the stairs the same way to the secret entrance, go back **north** to the hidden ramp and go up it. From there return to Mal'ouquah by the ramp west of the Ankrahmun oasis.
Go back to {npc:Alesar} and say {key:DJANNI'HAH}, {key:mission} and {key:yes}. He tells you to talk to {npc:Malor}.

Go up to King {npc:Malor} and say {key:DJANNI'HAH}, {key:mission} and {key:yes}. He wants Fa'hradin's lamp, which the {npc:The Orc King|Orc King} has, and wants you to swap it for the lamp where Gabel sleeps.
Ask the Orc King for the lamp

Travel to **Venore** ({npc:Captain Sinbeard} takes you there: {key:hi}, {key:venore}, {key:yes}, 150 gp) and walk **northwest** to {wiki:Ulderek's Rock|Ulderek's Rock} (Orc Fortress). Go down to the throne room, 2 floors below ground (to enter the chamber you need **level 40**), and talk to the {npc:The Orc King|Orc King}. At the first {key:hi} he summons many orcs. Say {key:hi} again, then {key:lamp} and answer {key:malor}. You receive {item:Gemmed Lamp (Fa'hradin's)|Fa'hradin's lamp}.
When you say {key:hi}, the Orc King summons several types of orcs ({creature:Orc Warlord|Orc Warlords}, {creature:Orc Leader|Orc Leaders}, {creature:Orc Berserker|Orc Berserkers}...).
Place a {item:Poison Bomb Rune|poison bomb} centred on yourself before greeting him: it helps you avoid being surrounded.
Leave the fort the same way you came in and walk **southeast** back to Venore. There {npc:Captain Fearless} takes you to Ankrahmun ({key:hi}, {key:ankrahmun}, {key:yes}, 150 gp).
Do not stop to rest near the fort: the orcs move in large groups.
Climbing to the top of the Marids' fortress
Go back to the secret entrance of the blue djinns' fortress (as in mission 2) and go up the stairs **to the top**, where {npc:Gabel}'s personal room is.

You will face LOTS of {creature:Blue Djinn|Blue Djinns}, {creature:Marid|Marids}, {creature:Scarab|Scarabs} and {creature:Fire Elemental|Fire Elementals}. In the room there are 3 Marids and their summons. Bring at least one {item:Dwarven Ring} and a good team: a level 80+ knight or a high-level paladin/mage for the room. A level 70+ knight can clear the way to the last floor, but will struggle in the room.

In Gabel's room, with Fa'hradin's lamp in your inventory, **use** the lamp with precious stones on his counter. Then go back down the same way to the secret entrance and leave by the hidden ramp, to the **north**.

Go back to {npc:Malor} in Mal'ouquah and say {key:hi} (or {key:DJANNI'HAH}), {key:mission} and {key:yes}. From now on you can trade with {npc:Yaman} and {npc:Alesar}. You can also ask Malor for a Blue Djinn hunting {key:task}.
Permission to trade with Yaman and Alesar
If you prefer to ally with the blue djinns, do the {wiki:The Djinn War - Marid Faction|The Djinn War - Marid Faction} instead. You cannot do both.
{npc:Yaman} and {npc:Alesar} buy and sell different equipment from the Marids.
